categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: power discrete devices (including wafer, power components, and control modules manufacturing and sales), power integrated circuits and components (including power ICs, power MOSFETs, and fast recovery diodes), and solar energy (solar power station electricity sales). The power discrete devices segment accounts for the majority of sales, followed by power ICs and solar energy.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on semiconductor wafer design, manufacturing, and assembly, specializing in silicon-based power devices and third-generation compound semiconductors such as SiC (silicon carbide). Key technologies include high-voltage super-junction MOSFETs, shielded-gate trench MOSFETs, fast recovery epitaxial diodes (FREDs), insulated-gate bipolar transistors (IGBTs), and SiC Schottky diodes and MOSFETs. Manufacturing emphasizes advanced wafer processing, packaging technologies (including TOLL and DFN series), and automation with MES systems to improve production efficiency and quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves a broad range of customers in industries such as consumer electronics (smartphones, laptops, AI devices), automotive (including electric vehicles and charging infrastructure), industrial control, renewable energy (solar and wind power), power supplies, and communication equipment. Major end markets include global automotive manufacturers, industrial equipment makers, and consumer electronics OEMs.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan with manufacturing facilities in Kaohsiung and overseas production lines in China and Southeast Asia. Sales are concentrated in Asia (about 75% of revenue), with additional markets in Europe, the Americas, and other regions. The company is expanding its presence in Japan and maintains international sales and support offices.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the semiconductor supply chain, encompassing wafer fabrication, device manufacturing, packaging, and module assembly. It integrates wafer design and manufacturing with packaging and testing, serving as an IDM (Integrated Device Manufacturer) with some vertical integration in wafer processing and assembly.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include innovation in high-power semiconductor devices, especially MOSFETs and SiC products, to meet growing demand in electric vehicles, industrial control, and renewable energy. The company invests heavily in R&D for advanced power discrete devices, third-generation semiconductors, and power ICs (including power management and motor control ICs). It emphasizes product performance improvements, packaging miniaturization, and expanding automotive-grade product certifications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of semiconductor discrete devices, power ICs, and solar power electricity. The company also earns income from technology consulting and licensing related to its semiconductor products. Sales are made to OEMs and system integrators across various industries.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Key competitors include global semiconductor companies such as Infineon, STMicroelectronics, ROHM, Vishay, Diodes Inc., Onsemi, and Nexperia, as well as Chinese firms like Silan Microelectronics and Yangjie. The company positions itself as a leading Taiwanese IDM in power discrete semiconductors with a focus on high-quality, high-performance products and a comprehensive product line to compete globally.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$12.5 billion in the latest fiscal year, with a slight decrease from the prior year but improved gross margin and net profit. Net income attributable to the parent company was about NT$918 million, showing growth. The company maintains a stable asset base of around NT$28.7 billion and equity of NT$15.5 billion, with ongoing investments in R&D and production capacity to support growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes superior product quality, extensive manufacturing experience, and a broad product portfolio covering various power semiconductor devices. It differentiates through advanced technology development in silicon and wide bandgap semiconductors (SiC, GaN), strong vertical integration, and the ability to provide comprehensive solutions including power ICs. Its commitment to automation, low defect rates, and global certifications supports its competitive edge in high-reliability applications such as automotive and industrial markets.
